Traffic Advisory Boulder Canyon

Boulder Canyon is closed at mile marker 32.1 due to a bus that slid off the roadway and is currently stuck. @RideRTD has a large wrecker on scene actively working to remove the bus. The closure will remain in place until the recovery is complete.

An alternate route for travel up or down the mountain is Sugarloaf.

Road conditions throughout the area are poor with snow packed and slick surfaces. If you must drive, slow down, increase following distance, and expect delays.

If you are traveling, make sure your vehicle is prepared. Carry water, food, and extra clothing in case you become stuck or delayed.

We will provide updates as conditions change and the roadway reopens.

data.text:
🚨PHILIPPINES:  Ferry Sinks Off Southern Philippines; 15 Dead, Hundreds Rescued

A ferry, the M/V Trisha Kerstin 3, sank early Monday (local time) in waters near Basilan province in the southern Philippines, prompting a major rescue operation. The vessel was traveling from Zamboanga City to Jolo Island when it went down just over a nautical mile from Baluk‑baluk Island.

Authorities say at least 15 people have died, while more than 300 passengers and crew were rescued. The ferry was carrying over 330 passengers and 27 crew members at the time of the accident.

Rescue teams from the Philippine Coast Guard, Navy, Air Force, and local agencies, along with nearby fishing boats, have been searching the waters for survivors. Officials noted that weather conditions were calm and there were no immediate signs of overloading, though the cause of the sinking is still under investigation.
